description: Rough control points for georeference_zone_map.py on the City of Braunschweig zone map 1a/1b (raw_sources/bs_zone_map_1a_1b.jpg): image pixel (px, py) read by eye at four street junctions, world coordinates (E, N, EPSG:25832) = intersection of the named OSM ways in the Overpass response of 2026-09-29. They only seed the global search; the fit uses the street network.
